label: Türkiye: Istanbul + Cappadocia
summary: 3 nights Istanbul, 4 in Göreme cave hostel; balloon tries, valley hikes. On existing TK route: flights ~+$150 pp. All-in ~$2,760 pp (~+$1,260 over Kenya-only).
verdict: Easiest, cheapest stopover: on TK route, no visa, short transfers, Christmas among rock churches. Weak wildlife (birds, cats), cold grey winter, ~50/50 balloon odds per morning.

safety.advisory_level: US State Dept Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution (page dated Jun 9 2026). Do not travel to southeast Türkiye or the Syria/Iraq border region.
safety.summary: Istanbul + Cappadocia: Level 2, far from no-go southeast. Risks: terrorism in crowds, protests, anti-US mood since Feb 28 2026 US–Iran hostilities, scams; Consulate Adana drawn down (off-route). Practical: icy trails, balloon operator choice; re-check advisory pre-departure.
precautions: Enroll STEP; re-check travel.state.gov week before (advisory updated twice in 2026).
Low profile as Americans: skip demos/political gatherings; no posts criticizing Turkish state.
Exit plan without US govt help; TK ticket out of IST is built-in exit.
Alert in crowds: Sultanahmet, Istiklal, bazaars, transit hubs, holidays/New Year.
Sultanahmet scams: dropped shoe brush, 'let's have a drink' bars, carpet hard sells. Use BiTaksi/metered taxi.
Balloons: SHGM-licensed, well-reviewed only; accept weather calls; avoid anyone flying when others grounded.
Traction spikes/grippy boots (Rose, Red, Love valleys ice over); offline map (Maps.me/AllTrails).
Secure passports. Basilica Cistern: card/Istanbulkart only, no cash.

visa: US passport: visa-free tourism, 90 days per 180 (since early 2024; no e-visa). Passport valid 6 months past stay (safe choice). Kenya eTA still needed.
weather_dec: Istanbul ~5–11°C, grey, damp, windy; rain ~1 day in 2; sunset ~16:40. Cappadocia ~−3 to 5°C, freezing nights, possible snow, icy trails. Balloons fly ~50–60% of mornings (unverified); plan 4 dawns. Pack layers, hat, gloves, waterproof boots (also for Kenya dawn drives).
highlights: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapı: all walkable from Sultanahmet
Şehir Hatları Bosphorus ferry (~$10–20): two continents, shearwaters, cormorants, slim dolphin chance
Christmas Day at Göreme Open Air Museum + Dark Church (10th–12th c. frescoes)
4 dawn balloon chances, or free view of ~100 balloons rising
Easy–moderate hikes: Rose, Red, Love, Pigeon valleys to Uçhisar castle, maybe snow
Green Tour: Derinkuyu underground city (8 levels) + Ihlara canyon walk
No visa, shortest flights; on TK routing, ASR→IST→NBO protected on one ticket
drawbacks: Weakest wildlife: mostly birds, off-peak at Sultan Sazlığı. Fails 'wildlife first'.
Cold, grey: Cappadocia mornings below freezing, Istanbul drizzly.
Balloons fly ~50–60% of mornings; 4 tries, no guarantee. Book full refund if all cancelled.
Balloon ~$180 pp winter (~$100–330); comfort baskets more; ground view free.
Christmas–New Year busy; book cave rooms early.
More volatile since Feb 2026 US–Iran hostilities; still Level 2, anti-US sentiment up.
Long Dec 27: shuttle, domestic flight, ~3h layover, 6h45 to NBO, land ~01:25; Dec 28 rest day.
Istanbul fees high, in euros: Topkapı ~€55, Cistern ~€38, Hagia Sophia €25.
Upgrades: boutique cave hotel $150–300/room/night vs ~$80; guide ~$150/day; Pamukkale doesn't fit.

legs.detail: TK10 nonstop 777-300ER. Winter schedule (from Oct 24): LAX 19:45 → IST 19:00 Dec 20 (+11h). Some sites show 20:00–20:10; verify. First segment of multi-city TK ticket.
Havaist bus (~$5–8) or M11 metro + T1 tram. Taxi ~$35–45/car, sensible for ~20:00 arrival.
Havaist bus or tram + metro to IST. SAW (~1.5h) if cheaper Pegasus/AJet fare leaves there.
Late-morning domestic to Kayseri, ~$40–110 one way. TK several daily (737); AJet/Pegasus from SAW often cheapest. NAV closer (40 min), fewer flights.
Pre-booked shared shuttle (Helios/Kapadokya Express, ~$12–15 pp) to Göreme hostel door.
Shared shuttle to Kayseri late morning, after last dawn balloon try.
TK ASR→IST midday/early afternoon (TK2011/TK2013; summer 2026 08:40, 10:40; winter differs). Same multi-city ticket protects NBO connection; aim 3h+ layover.
TK607 IST 18:40 → NBO 01:25 Mon Dec 28. Trackers confirm 18:40–18:45/01:25 through Sep 2026; older: 20:30 → 03:05. Both arrive before 06:00. Reconfirm.

itinerary.title: Arrive Istanbul
itinerary.details: Land IST ~19:00. Bus/metro/taxi to Sultanahmet ~1.25–1.5h. Check in, short walk to lit Blue Mosque, sleep.
itinerary.meals: Meals on the plane; light late dinner near the hostel (döner, pide)

itinerary.title: Old City on foot
itinerary.details: All walking. Hagia Sophia at opening (€25), Blue Mosque (free, modest dress), Basilica Cistern (~€38, card only), Hippodrome. Afternoon: Grand Bazaar. Early night.
itinerary.meals: Hostel breakfast; simit and street-food lunch; lokanta dinner

itinerary.title: Bosphorus + Topkapı
itinerary.details: Topkapı + Harem ~€55; closed Tuesdays (Dec 22 is Tue), so swap with Dec 21. Afternoon: Şehir Hatları ferry from Eminönü (~1.5h each way, cheap): shearwaters, cormorants, maybe dolphins. Or ferry to Kadıköy food market. Spice Bazaar on return.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; balık-ekmek (fish sandwich) at Eminönü; meyhane dinner in Kadıköy

itinerary.title: Fly to Cappadocia
itinerary.details: Bus ~1.25h + flight ~1.5h + shuttle ~1h ≈ 3.75h plus airport time. Check into cave room; walk to Sunset Point. Confirm balloon pickup.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; airport snack; testi kebab (pottery-pot stew) dinner

itinerary.title: Balloon #1 + Red/Rose Valley
itinerary.details: ~05:30 pickup, ~1h flight, ~50–60% odds; if cancelled, watch from roof. Late morning: Rose/Red Valley loop ~3–4h, easy–moderate, icy spots, sunset view. Christmas Eve dinner.
itinerary.meals: Cave breakfast spread; packed lunch; Christmas Eve dinner out

itinerary.title: Christmas among rock churches
itinerary.details: Dawn: balloon backup. Open Air Museum (€20) + Dark Church (€6), ~2–3h, 15-min walk. Afternoon: Love/Pigeon Valley to Uçhisar Castle ~2–3h; bus/taxi back ~15 min. Relaxed.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; gözleme lunch; dinner in Uçhisar or Göreme

itinerary.title: Green Tour: Derinkuyu + Ihlara
itinerary.details: Dawn: balloon backup. 09:30 minibus (~$45–80 with lunch; check entries, Derinkuyu ~€13): Derinkuyu, Ihlara river walk ~1.5h, Selime monastery. ~2.5h driving total; back ~17:30.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; lunch included by the river; easy dinner

itinerary.title: Fly to Nairobi
itinerary.details: Dawn: last balloon backup/viewpoint. Shuttle ~1h, ASR→IST ~1h35, ~3h connection, TK607 18:40 → NBO 01:25 Dec 28 (~6h45). Dec 28 rest day.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast; lunch at the airport; dinner on board

lodging.name: Cheers Hostel (or similar Sultanahmet hostel)
lodging.why: Old City sights walkable; T1 tram at door to ferry.
lodging.alternatives: Sultan Hostel, Bunk Hostel Taksim (livelier), Agora Life (pricier)

lodging.name: Diadem Cappadocia Guest House & Hostel (or similar cave hostel)
lodging.includes: Breakfast; heated cave room; balloon-view rooftop; balloon/tour desk
lodging.why: Real cave room; walk to trailheads and Open Air Museum; balloon/Green Tour door pickups.
lodging.alternatives: Kamelya, Garden Cave, HomeStay Cave hostels; upgrade: Kelebek or Sultan Cave Suites ($150–300/room)

budget.item: TK multi-city: LAX→IST Dec 19; ASR→IST→NBO Dec 27; NBO→IST→LAX Jan 16
budget.notes: Replaces $1,500 base (~+$150 pp). Off-peak RT from ~$1,000; no Dec 2026 fare verified; Dec 19 peak. ASR origin protects connection. TK Stopover free hotel likely N/A on multi-city.
AJet/Pegasus cheapest (bag fees); TK from IST pricier, simpler.

budget.item: Göreme cave hostel private double, 4 nights
budget.notes: $40 pppn with breakfast; holiday week pricier, book early.
Optional. Winter 2026 ~€90–220 standard; comfort more; $0 ground view. Check cancellation refund.

budget.item: Istanbul entries: Hagia Sophia, Topkapı+Harem, Cistern
budget.notes: Hagia Sophia €25; Topkapı ~2,750 TL (~€55, one source €85); Cistern 1,950 TL (~€38, repricing after Jun 2026 handover). Mosques free.

budget.item: Göreme Open Air Museum + Dark Church, Uçhisar
budget.notes: €20 + €6; Uçhisar castle extra. Valleys free, minor trail tolls.
Havaist ×2, Kayseri shuttle ×2, tram, ferry; taxis extra.
~$30/day: breakfasts included, lokanta/street food, some sit-down dinners. High inflation; check prices.

budget.item: eSIM, tips, insurance increment, trail spikes

booking.task: Book TK multi-city: LAX→IST Dec 19 / ASR→IST→NBO Dec 27 / NBO→IST→LAX Jan 16; compare to $1,500 base.
Reserve Istanbul + Göreme hostels, free cancellation; holiday cave rooms fill.
Book IST/SAW→Kayseri Dec 23 (or add to TK ticket); pre-book Kayseri shuttles both ways.
Book Dec 24 balloon: SHGM-licensed, rebooks Dec 25–27, full refund if all cancelled.
Book Dec 26 Green Tour; eSIMs; STEP; microspikes; re-check advisory.
Check next morning's balloon status each evening; roll forward if cancelled.
Reconfirm TK607 (18:40 vs 20:30) and ASR→IST times; online check-in; Kenya eTA ready.

fatigue: Dec 19: ~13h flight (overnight). Dec 20: arrive ~19:00, ~1.25–1.5h road. Dec 21: 0h. Dec 22: 0h road (ferry ~3h RT, seated). Dec 23: ~3.75h door to door (1.25h road + 1.5h flight + 1h road). Dec 24: 0h (3–4h hike). Dec 25: 0h (2–3h hike). Dec 26: ~2.5h road, spread out. Dec 27: 1h road + 1.6h flight + ~3h layover + 6.75h flight, land NBO 01:25 Dec 28 (~12h). Dec 28: Nairobi rest. Pace rules met: max ~2.5h road/day; easy days after arrival and before Dec 27; rest day after.
safety_short: Far from restricted southeast. Risks: low-odds crowd attack, protests (anti-US mood since Feb 2026 US–Iran hostilities), scams, icy trails.
